# The primitives

What each primitive is: its role, how it is named, the states it carries, its props, events and keys. This page is generated from the specifications in `packages/primitives/specs`, which are checked against the HTML Standard, ARIA in HTML and the Accessible Name and Description Computation by the primitives' tests (`docs/direction/implementation.md`, WP3). A primitive is **portable** when it is the same on every target, **web-only** or **desktop-only** when it is on one.

## What `vlx` checks of a use

- **`unnamed-control`**: a control whose name comes from a prop (`checkbox`, `radio`, `radiogroup`, `textfield`) has a `label`, or is inside a `<label>` that says what it is for. A reusable component that takes its name from whoever uses it says which prop that is in its contract, `component(template, { props: { label: Schema.String }, name: "label" })`: the prop must be a string every use writes (a use that omits it is reported where it is written), the template must read it (`name-unused` otherwise), and a control in it with no name of its own is not reported.
- **`list-child`**: a `list` holds only `listitem`s (also under `{#if}` and `{#each}`); text or another primitive in it is reported. **`outside-container`**: a `listitem` is inside a `list` or `olist`, a `radio` inside a `radiogroup`.

## a

A link inside text.

- **Status**: web-only
- **Role**: `link`
- **Accessible name**: the text inside it
- **Content**: text

| Prop | Type | Required | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `href` | string | yes |  |

## alert

A live region for a message that cannot wait. Assertive and atomic. It exists before its text does.

- **Status**: portable
- **Role**: `alert`
- **Accessible name**: nothing of its own (a name comes from where it is used)
- **Content**: text
- **Live region**: assertive, atomic

## article

A self-contained piece of content (an article role).

- **Status**: web-only
- **Role**: `generic` (on the web `article`)
- **Accessible name**: nothing of its own (a name comes from where it is used)
- **Content**: anything

## aside

Content aside from the content around it (a complementary landmark).

- **Status**: web-only
- **Role**: `generic` (on the web `complementary`)
- **Accessible name**: nothing of its own (a name comes from where it is used)
- **Content**: anything

| Prop | Type | Required | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `class` | string | yes | web only |

## blockquote

A quotation set apart from the text around it.

- **Status**: portable
- **Role**: `blockquote`
- **Accessible name**: nothing of its own (a name comes from where it is used)
- **Content**: text

| Prop | Type | Required | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `class` | string | no | web only |

## button

Something to press. Its name is its content, or `label` for a button that is an icon.

- **Status**: portable
- **Role**: `button`
- **Accessible name**: its `label` when given, otherwise the text inside it
- **Content**: text
- **States**: disabled (`disabled`)
- **Early press**: replayed once the application has started (the default)
- **Keys**: Enter raises `click`; Space raises `click`

| Prop | Type | Required | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `disabled` | boolean | no | state |
| `label` | string | no | name |
| `class` | string | no | web only |
| `pressed` | string | no | web only |
| `intent` | "neutral" | "primary" | "danger" | no |  |
| `size` | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | no |  |

| Event | Payload | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `click` | none | The person pressed it. |

## cell

One cell of a row.

- **Status**: desktop-only, inside `table`, `tablebody`, `tablerow`
- **Role**: `cell`
- **Accessible name**: nothing of its own (a name comes from where it is used)
- **Content**: text

## checkbox

A box that is ticked or not. The application owns the value.

- **Status**: portable
- **Role**: `checkbox`
- **Accessible name**: its `label`, or a `label` around it
- **Content**: none
- **States**: checked (`checked`), invalid (`invalid`)
- **Early press**: replayed once the application has started (the default)
- **Keys**: Space raises `change`

| Prop | Type | Required | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` | boolean | yes | the application's value; state |
| `label` | string | no | name |
| `invalid` | boolean | no | state |
| `describedby` | string | no | relationship |

| Event | Payload | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `change` | boolean | The person changed the value; carries the new value. |

## code

Text that is code, shown in a monospace face. The role is ARIA 1.2's and HTML-AAM's for `code`; it is outside version 1's role set, so a Desktop that draws it as a label is a listed difference.

- **Status**: portable
- **Role**: `code`
- **Accessible name**: nothing of its own (a name comes from where it is used)
- **Content**: text

## column

Lays its children out in a vertical stack. It has no role: it is layout, not meaning.

- **Status**: portable
- **Role**: none
- **Accessible name**: nothing of its own (a name comes from where it is used)
- **Content**: anything

## columnheader

A cell that names its column; `sort` says how the column is sorted.

- **Status**: desktop-only, inside `table`, `tablehead`, `tablerow`
- **Role**: `columnheader`
- **Accessible name**: the text inside it
- **Content**: text

| Prop | Type | Required | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sort` | string | no |  |

- **Status**: web-only

- **Accessible name**: nothing of its own (a name comes from where it is used)
- **Content**: anything

| `class` | string | yes | web only |

## header

The introductory content of a page or section. HTML-AAM: a banner landmark when it is the page's header, otherwise generic; landmarks are outside version 1's role set.

- **Status**: web-only
- **Role**: `generic` (on the web `banner`)
- **Accessible name**: nothing of its own (a name comes from where it is used)
- **Content**: anything

| Prop | Type | Required | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `class` | string | yes | web only |

## heading

A title for the content that follows. `level` is 1 to 6; a heading without one is level 2 on the web and level 1 on the Desktop (a difference the parity report lists).

- **Status**: portable
- **Role**: `heading`
- **Accessible name**: the text inside it
- **Content**: text
- **States**: level (`level`)

| Prop | Type | Required | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `level` | number | no | level |

## image

A picture. `label` describes it for people who cannot see it; the web realizes it as `alt`.

- **Status**: portable
- **Role**: `img`
- **Accessible name**: its `label`
- **Content**: none

| Prop | Type | Required | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | string | yes |  |
| `label` | string | yes | name |
| `class` | string | no | web only |
| `loading` | string | no | web only |

## label

A caption and the control it names, by containment: the text written directly inside is the control's name. It has no role of its own.

- **Status**: portable
- **Role**: none
- **Accessible name**: nothing of its own (a name comes from where it is used)
- **Content**: anything

## link

A link to an address. Its name is its content, or `label` for a link that is an icon.

- **Status**: portable
- **Role**: `link`
- **Accessible name**: the text inside it
- **Content**: text
- **Keys**: Enter raises `activate`

| Prop | Type | Required | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `href` | string | yes |  |
| `class` | string | no | web only |
| `current` | string | no | web only |

## list

A list of items. `ordered` says whether the order is meaning. Its children are items: HTML's content model allows nothing else in a list.

- **Status**: portable
- **Role**: `list`
- **Accessible name**: nothing of its own (a name comes from where it is used)
- **Content**: only `listitem`

| Prop | Type | Required | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ordered` | boolean | no |  |
| `class` | string | no | web only |

- **Status**: portable, inside `list`
- **Role**: `listitem`
- **Accessible name**: nothing of its own (a name comes from where it is used)
- **Content**: anything

## radio

One option of a radio group. The application decides which one is selected.

- **Status**: portable, inside `radiogroup`
- **Role**: `radio`
- **Accessible name**: its `label`, or a `label` around it
- **Content**: none
- **States**: checked (`checked`), disabled (`disabled`)
- **Early press**: replayed once the application has started (the default)
- **Keys**: Space raises `select`; ArrowDown moves to the next; ArrowRight moves to the next; ArrowUp moves to the previous; ArrowLeft moves to the previous

| Prop | Type | Required | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` | boolean | yes | the application's value; state |
| `value` | string | yes |  |
| `label` | string | no | name |
| `disabled` | boolean | no | state |

| Event | Payload | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `select` | string | The person chose it; carries its value. |

## radiogroup

A group of radios: choose one of a few. It has no events; its radios raise them.

- **Status**: portable
- **Role**: `radiogroup`
- **Accessible name**: its `label`
- **Content**: only `radio`, `label`
- **States**: invalid (`invalid`)

| Prop | Type | Required | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string | no | name |
| `invalid` | boolean | no | state |
| `describedby` | string | no | relationship |

## row

Lays its children out in a horizontal line. It has no role: it is layout, not meaning.

- **Status**: portable
- **Role**: none
- **Accessible name**: nothing of its own (a name comes from where it is used)
- **Content**: anything

## rowheader

A cell that names its row.

- **Status**: desktop-only, inside `table`, `tablebody`, `tablerow`

- **Accessible name**: the text inside it
- **Content**: text

## section

A section of the content. HTML-AAM: a region landmark when it has a name, generic when it has none.

- **Status**: web-only
- **Role**: `generic`
- **Accessible name**: nothing of its own (a name comes from where it is used)
- **Content**: anything

## shell

The outermost box of a page; `theme` selects a variant of the style.

- **Status**: web-only
- **Role**: `generic`
- **Accessible name**: nothing of its own (a name comes from where it is used)
- **Content**: anything

| Prop | Type | Required | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `class` | string | yes | web only |
| `theme` | string | yes | web only |

## span

A run of text with a `class`.

- **Status**: web-only
- **Role**: `generic`
- **Accessible name**: nothing of its own (a name comes from where it is used)
- **Content**: text

| Prop | Type | Required | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `class` | string | yes | web only |

## status

A live region: the text inside is a message about what just happened. Polite and atomic. It exists before its text does, so a message put into it is announced.

- **Status**: portable
- **Role**: `status`
- **Accessible name**: nothing of its own (a name comes from where it is used)
- **Content**: text
- **Live region**: polite, atomic

## strong

Text of strong importance.

- **Status**: portable
- **Role**: `strong`
- **Accessible name**: nothing of its own (a name comes from where it is used)
- **Content**: text

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string | no | name |

## tablebody

The body rows of a table.

- **Status**: desktop-only, inside `table`

- **Accessible name**: nothing of its own (a name comes from where it is used)

- **Status**: desktop-only, inside `table`

A run of text. Text is text: nothing in it is markup. Its `id` is what a control's `describedby` points at.

| Prop | Type | Required | |

| `id` | string | no | description-target |

## textfield

A line of text the person edits. The application owns the value.

- **Status**: portable
- **Role**: `textbox`
- **Accessible name**: its `label`, or a `label` around it
- **Content**: none
- **States**: invalid (`invalid`)
- **Early press**: replayed once the application has started (the default)
- **Keys**: Enter raises `submit`; Escape raises `cancel`

| Prop | Type | Required | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | string | yes | the application's value |
| `placeholder` | string | no |  |
| `label` | string | no | name |
| `kind` | string | no |  |
| `invalid` | boolean | no | state |
| `describedby` | string | no | relationship |

| Event | Payload | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `change` | string | The text changed; carries the new text. |
| `submit` | none | Enter: the person is done with what they typed. |
| `cancel` | none | Escape: the person backs out of what they typed. |
| `focus` | none | The person came into the field. |
| `blur` | none | The person left the field. |

- **States**: pressed (`pressed`), disabled (`disabled`)
- **Early press**: replayed once the application has started (the default)
- **Keys**: Enter raises `change`; Space raises `change`

| Prop | Type | Required | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pressed` | boolean | yes | the application's value; state |
| `label` | string | no | name |
| `disabled` | boolean | no | state |
| `class` | string | no | web only |

| Event | Payload | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `change` | boolean | The person pressed it; carries the new value. |
